result_label: M7 derived paired comparative summaries over the durable M5/M6 archives; descriptive statistics over 10 seeds; NO superiority claims; seed-level pairing preserved (item 20); bootstrap resamples complete seed pairs (item 21)

methods.bootstrap: percentile CI on the mean paired difference; B=10000; seed 2026; seed-level pairs resampled as units
methods.wilcoxon: two-sided signed-rank on non-zero paired differences (zero_method wilcox); Holm-corrected across the presented family

bootstrap_ci.note: uncertainty from ten runs is descriptive only; a narrow interval is NOT evidence of universal superiority (item 21 limitation)

documentation.null_hypothesis: the median of the paired per-seed differences is zero
documentation.alternative_hypothesis: the median of the paired per-seed differences is not zero (two-sided)
documentation.zero_difference_handling: zero differences are DROPPED (scipy zero_method='wilcox') and reduce the effective sample size
documentation.tie_handling: equal absolute differences receive averaged ranks (scipy normal-approximation fallback when ties/zeroes are present)
documentation.assumptions: paired differences are treated as (approximately) symmetrically distributed around the median; n is small (10), so exact-vs-approximate mode follows scipy 'auto'
documentation.policy: p-values COMPLEMENT effect sizes and bootstrap intervals; no practical significance is inferred from p-values alone (item 22)
